tesseract.js 5.1.1
tesseract.js-core 5.1.1
eng.traineddata: tessdata 4.0.0_fast

Vendored, not fetched at runtime: MV3 forbids remote code, and OCR must stay
on the user's machine. The JS bundles use a reproducible modern-browser adaptation of upstream 5.1.1.
Do not overwrite them with upstream minified bundles: that restores obsolete eval
fallbacks. See docs/MOZILLA-REVIEW.md and scripts/build-ocr-vendor.mjs.
The combined WASM core and English language data remain unchanged.

FILE CHOICE MATTERS. The worker importScripts()s tesseract-core-simd-lstm.wasm.js
by name -- the build with the wasm embedded. Vendoring the split
tesseract-core-simd-lstm.js + .wasm pair is smaller but fails at runtime with a
NetworkError, which no unit test catches. tests/harness-ocr.html exercises the real
vendored files in a browser; run it after any update here.

SIMD only. Chrome has supported wasm SIMD since v91 (2021). On a build without it
the worker would ask for the non-SIMD variant, not find it, and OCR would fail --
degrading to the existing "couldn't read the ingredients" card rather than breaking.
